bullets: Christians in Uganda killed and communities endangered for sheltering and sharing faith with Muslim-background converts, families and believers left grieving and at risk.
Colombian Christians bereaved after a pastor was beaten to death while evangelizing gang members, leaving young children without a father and a congregation in mourning.
Catholic churches across France desecrated and vandalized amid widespread civil unrest, congregations shaken and sacred spaces violated.
Christians in Israel facing a documented rise in anti-Christian harassment, church desecration, and destruction of sacred property, with incidents reaching new quarterly highs.

Christian communities in Nigeria suffering targeted killings, unjust imprisonment, and a climate of violence, including farmers ambushed for their faith, a humanitarian worker shot dead, and a mother sentenced to 14 years for sharing her beliefs.
Pakistani Christians facing execution and mob violence under blasphemy laws, including a father on death row after a decade imprisoned and a teenager still recovering from a brutal mob assault.
A pastor and his wife killed by gunmen in Mexico, leaving teenage children and a congregation without their shepherd and seeking justice.
Christians in India imprisoned on false charges following worship events, and thousands more endangered when an armed mob violently disrupted an indigenous Christian convention.
Foreign Christians detained in Nepal on legal uncertainty after participating in theological training, facing possible deportation.
Christian convert in Egypt facing life imprisonment for seeking legal recognition of his faith, his trial ongoing with his freedom at stake.
Churches bombed and burned in Myanmar within days as part of ongoing military operations in predominantly Christian areas, civilian communities left without shelter.
Christians in Kenya grieving the murder of nearly 200 children by a convicted cult, families and survivors in need of justice and deep healing.

House churches and congregations in China facing formal bans, dissolution, repeated detentions of pastors and ministry workers, and obstruction of legal defense, as state pressure on independent believers intensifies.
Christian residents of a Palestinian village in the West Bank attacked by masked individuals during the olive harvest season, facing repeated violence and insecurity.
Small Christian congregation in Indonesia ordered to suspend worship under government pressure, its members facing intimidation and the loss of religious freedom.
Christian woman rescued in DR Congo after years of captivity and forced religious coercion by an armed group, still recovering while other believers remain held.
Civilians across Sudan — including children, market traders, and aid workers — killed and displaced by surging drone strikes and armed violence.
Millions of civilians in eastern Congo caught between rebel group attacks, political crisis, and repeated ceasefire failures.
Christian communities in Myanmar whose places of worship were destroyed by airstrikes and arson amid ongoing armed conflict.
Somali civilians near the Kenyan border caught in an intensifying airstrike campaign targeting armed militants.
Children and civilians in Ethiopia's Tigray region injured by drone strikes amid renewed armed conflict.
Dozens of civilians — including children and elderly — massacred by militant fighters in eastern Mali.
Communities across Nigeria facing ISWAP insurgency, Boko Haram attacks, and mass abductions in multiple northern states.
Thousands of families in Mexico displaced by cartel violence, and families of workers killed or missing in mining-related kidnappings.
Civilians, peacekeepers, and residents in Haiti caught in escalating gang violence and armed ambushes near the capital.
Hundreds of thousands of displaced people in Yemen with no food, water, or medicine, and young military recruits killed in a missile strike.
Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank facing ongoing airstrikes, casualties, and violence amid a fragile post-ceasefire environment.
Saudi civilians and workers facing escalating Houthi missile attacks, airport closures, and a maritime blockade.
Students, teachers, and families across Greece, Albania, Portugal, and France caught in protests, civil unrest, and clashes with police over housing and cost-of-living crises.
A foreign national detained in Russia on mercenary charges with no transparent legal process or public accounting.
Families and communities in Colombia grieving the suppression of memorials to victims of political violence and human rights abuses.
Approximately 16,000 residents in the United States displaced by Southern California wildfires, with homes destroyed and firefighters injured.

Thousands of Nigerians displaced by severe flooding with homes and harvests lost, alongside the country's first confirmed Ebola case threatening rapid spread among healthcare workers and the wider population.
Families in Malaysia displaced by flash flooding with homes inundated and communities requiring emergency shelter.
Approximately 1,300 people in South Sudan displaced by flooding with urgent needs for shelter and humanitarian assistance.
Residents of Italy affected by Storm Adam flooding, displaced and awaiting emergency relief.
Nearly 874,000 people in Somalia at risk of displacement as seasonal flooding continues to rise and threaten communities.
Residents of Spain grieving deaths and cut off by severe flooding brought by a powerful storm system affecting hundreds of municipalities.
River communities in Russia facing critically low water levels disrupting navigation and threatening livelihoods.
Residents of Papua New Guinea, Iceland, the United States, South Africa, and Vanuatu shaken by multiple earthquakes, with communities assessing damage and vulnerability.
